verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly establishes the USB-to-VMID path and requires VMID and VSYS to remain separate nets.

value_updates.normal_operation_power_path: The battery feeds AXP2101, which powers the system in normal operation

verdicts.decision_note: The power-source relationships belong to this Requirement, but the DCDC1 current rating belongs to the narrower DCDC1 regulation or power-capacity Requirement.
The client accepts the integrated-board direction and requires simultaneous charging and operation; the modular power-board source key is consequently obsolete.
The client explicitly requires operation from USB without a connected battery.
First concrete USB-path failure: both boards worked from battery but suffered rail collapse and resets when operated from 5V USB.

source_message.speaker: freelancer

ambiguity.description: The freelancer cites a reference design with VMID and VSYS connected, conflicting with the client's requirement that they remain separate nets.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: But it must be battery efficient as aim will be to make battery work as long as possible.
